args.title: Fix dedupe logic to handle overlapping days in multiple statement uploads
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

Propose an update to the dedupe function to improve detection of duplicates across overlapping statement uploads. The current implementation misses duplicates when two statements containing overlapping days are uploaded together, causing those transactions to be recorded twice. The change should fix the duplicate detection logic to properly handle overlapping data in the same batch upload, preventing duplication in the ledger.
